summary: Andreessen argues that AI will greatly raise productivity and what people can build, and disputes predictions that it will eliminate programming jobs.

statements.quote: Software has been eating the world at the speed of human hands. It is about to eat the world at the speed of compute.
Every time programmers get more leverage, doomers predict the end of software engineering.
AI coding, this is the biggest earthquake to hit software in certainly my life, maybe since the invention of software.
My guess is we’ll have more coding jobs probably by an order of magnitude 10 years from now.
